data_fields.name: entry_at
data_fields.donor_constant: scroll position key, parsed from the entry (at)

data_fields.name: min_players_variant
data_fields.donor_constant: spawnplayer_count 0..3 for 1P..4P entries (threshold = count minus one)

data_fields.name: scroll_speed
data_fields.donor_constant: level->scrollspeed per step (value parse not read)

best_idea: A level director that spawns from an ordered, position-keyed list, refills a group between a minimum and a maximum live count, and holds a lock until the group is clear.
decision_why: Take the refill band (min, max) and the ordered entry list as zone data for zone population; key progress to server-side zone entry instead of a scroll clock; reject the donor's coupling of lock and bounds entries to the enemy band, and its consumption of failed spawns.
acceptance: Server test with band min 2, max 4: with 1 enemy alive and 4 spawn entries due, exactly 3 spawn in that step; with 2 alive none spawn; a lock entry at the head of the queue applies on the next step even while the band is full.
